prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Restore Your Companion or Create New Account", "Sign in to instantly sync your saved pets and progress safely across desktop devices.", "Cloud Restoration Protection Active"]
1: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Learn quick keyboard shortcuts and mouse clicks to interact, minimize, or talk with your pet anytime.", "Desktop Control Guide: Alt+H to Hide | Double Click to Speak"]
2: ["Meet Your Future Desktop Buddy", "Explore how your virtual pet reacts to your daily desktop activities before choosing your adoption journey."]
3: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Verify your personalized companion settings before bringing them onto your desktop."]
4: ["Preparing Desktop Environment...", "Checking overlay permissions and graphics rendering to ensure your pet appears smoothly.", "Desktop Window Layering: Verified"]
5: ["Upload Photo or Choose a Sample Reference", "Having trouble with custom photo quality? Select one of our curated style templates to continue instantly.", "Sample models ensure 100% generation accuracy.", "Use Verified Sample Photos"]
6: ["Sign In to Preserve & Sync Your Pet", "Your companion data is safe. Signing in restores your existing pet or locks your new pet to your account.", "Automatic Save Protection Enabled"]
7: ["Welcome to Your New Desktop Life!", "Right-click your companion anytime to access settings, feed them, or change desktop behavior.", "Tip: Right-click pet for main menu. Double click to chat!"]
8: ["Photo Clarity Checklist", "Follow these quick tips for the best custom pet model generation.", "Good lighting & clear subject focus"]
9: ["Sign In & Unlock Bonus Pet Accessory", "Create or sign in to your account to back up your companion and unlock an exclusive golden collar.", "Unlock Exclusive Golden Collar"]

verdicts.problem: Promises a bonus item / free extra accessory for signing in.
